breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt: it replaces the uniform distributed load with its resultant force wL = 900 N acting at midspan and applies the point load formula δ = PL³/(48EI) to compute the distributed load contribution. This is incorrect because replacing a UDL with its resultant does not preserve deflection behavior. The ground truth simply instructs using the two standard superposition cases (UDL formula δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) and point load formula δ = PL³/(48EI)) without any resultant substitution. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
